 **Legal Manager – Land \& Title**

 **YES / NO / CONDITIONAL** 
 recommendation — quickly and with evidence.
 



 This is not a conventional documentation or contract\-management role.
 



 You will sit close to the
 **land acquisition and development decision\-making process** 
 , with direct responsibility for Karnataka land due diligence.
 



**What You Will Own** 




**1\. First\-Hand Land Due Diligence** 




 Every incoming land parcel, JDA proposal or outright purchase comes to you first.
 



 You will:
 


* Review title and revenue documents.
* Trace the revenue and ownership chain.
* Identify legal and documentary gaps.
* Flag deal\-breakers and potential risks.
* Prepare a clear internal title opinion note.
* Give the MD a practical
 **YES / NO / CONDITIONAL** 
 recommendation.



**Target turnaround: 7–10 working days per parcel.** 




 External senior counsel steps in
 **after your internal file is substantially clean.** 








  





**2\. Build the Complete Title File** 




 You should know exactly
 **what to collect, where to obtain it and in what sequence.** 




 Your work will include:
 


* Pahani / RTC extracts
* Mutation Register (MR)
* Akarband
* 11E Sketch
* Section 4(1\) Tippani
* Index of Lands
* 10(1\) Extract
* 30\-year Encumbrance Certificates
* Mother deed tracing
* Survey records
* Conversion orders
* Revenue and registration records



 You will own the
 **collection, sequencing, indexing and completeness** 
 of the land title file.
 







  





**3\. Construct the Mother Deed Chain** 




 You should be comfortable going deep into the ownership history of a property.
 



 Trace and analyse:
 



**Sale Deeds → Gift Deeds → Partition Deeds → Family Arrangements → Inheritance → Court Orders / Decrees → Current Ownership** 




 Your job is to identify:
 


* Breaks in the title chain
* Unregistered transfers
* Missing documents
* Inconsistent ownership records
* Unexplained gaps
* Potentially defective transactions



**A clean title chain should be understandable on one table — not buried across 200 pages of documents.** 








  





**4\. Karnataka Land Law – This Is Critical** 




 You should be able to independently identify Karnataka\-specific risks involving:
 


* **PTCL Act**
* **Inam Abolition history**
* **Karnataka Land Reforms Act – Sections 79A / 79B**
* **Section 63 and conversion status**
* Old tenancy entries in Pahani
* Land ceiling
* Gramathana vs. revenue land
* BBMP / BDA / BMRDA jurisdiction
* Mutation and survey issues
* Phodi / re\-survey matters



**You should see the trap before the transaction gets into it.** 








  





**5\. Revenue \& Registry Liaison** 




 This is a hands\-on role.
 



 You should have direct experience working with:
 


* Tahsildar Office
* Sub\-Registrar Office
* Survey Department
* Assistant Commissioner
* Deputy Commissioner Office



 You should understand
 **which authority issues which document, what the practical turnaround is, and how to move a stuck file forward.** 




 We are looking for someone who has
 **personally handled these processes** 
 , not someone who has only instructed junior staff to do them.
 







  





**6\. Existing Project Title Files** 




 You will maintain and close documentation gaps for our ongoing projects and upcoming projects.
 



 When a bank, buyer, auditor or internal team asks for a document, you should be able to retrieve it quickly.
 



**Our expectation: any critical title document should be retrievable within 24 hours.** 








  





**7\. Buyer Documentation** 




 Approximately
 **30% of your role** 
 will involve project\-level legal documentation, including:
 


* Agreements of Sale
* Construction Agreements
* Sale Deeds
* Tripartite Agreements with home\-loan banks
* NOCs
* Cancellations
* Nomination changes







  





**8\. K\-RERA Execution** 




 You will support the execution and ongoing compliance process, including:
 


* Quarterly filings
* Amendment tracking
* Agent registrations
* Documentation and records



 Major drafting and registrations will continue to be supported by external counsel.
 







  





**What You Will NOT Own** 




 We have deliberately defined this role.
 



**You will not be responsible for:** 



* ❌ Issuing formal bank title opinions — external senior counsel will do this.
* ❌ Drafting major K\-RERA registration applications — external counsel handles this.
* ❌ Leading complex land litigation — external counsel leads; you manage facts and timelines.
* ❌ Tax, GST, stamp duty strategy — handled by our CA firm.
* ❌ Chasing building plan approvals — handled by the approvals consultant.



**Your job is to make the land transaction legally clear enough for the business to make an informed decision.** 








  





**Must\-Have Experience** 




**Qualification** 



* LLB from a recognised Indian university.
* Bar Council enrolment is preferred, but not mandatory.



**Experience** 



* **5–9 years PQE.**
* Minimum
 **4 years of hands\-on Karnataka land due diligence** 
 .
* Experience in one or more of the following environments:
* Bengaluru real estate developer's land/legal team
* Property law firm handling title opinions
* Bank\-panel title\-search practice with developer clients



**Technical Knowledge** 




 You should be able to independently read and interpret:
 


* Pahani / RTC
* Mutation Register
* Akarband
* 11E Sketch
* Section 4(1\) Tippani
* Phodi / Podi records
* Revenue records



 You should have working knowledge of:
 


* Karnataka Land Revenue Act
* Karnataka Land Reforms Act
* Sections 79A / 79B
* Section 63
* PTCL Act
* Inam Abolition Acts
* Karnataka Stamp Act
* Registration Act



**One Non\-Negotiable** 




**Kannada reading is required.** 




 Original Karnataka revenue records are frequently in Kannada. We need someone who can read and interpret them directly without depending on a translator for routine diligence.
 







  





**We Would Particularly Value** 



* Experience drafting and negotiating
 **Joint Development Agreements (JDAs)** 
 .
* Experience with Gramathana / revenue\-site / conversion disputes.
* Record\-of\-rights rectification and mutation corrections.
* Phodi / re\-survey issues.

**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within your first year, we want to see a land legal function where:

**Deal\-breakers are identified early.** 




**Title files are complete and structured.** 




**The MD gets a clear commercial legal view — not a 100\-page document dump.** 




**External counsel spends time validating and resolving the important issues, rather than discovering basic gaps.** 




**Land acquisition decisions become faster, better documented and significantly more predictable.**

description:
**About Scimplify**
 Scimplify is a high\-growth, VC\-backed advanced materials and specialty chemicals company solving one of manufacturing’s toughest problems: scaling complex chemistry from lab to production at cost. **Role Overview**
 We are looking for a
 **Payroll Manager – Payroll \& Compliance** 
 to own and manage the organization’s end\-to\-end payroll function. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate, timely and compliant payroll processing while driving strong payroll controls, statutory compliance, reconciliations, audits and reporting.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in
 **end\-to\-end payroll, statutory compliance, payroll taxation, payroll systems and payroll accounting** 
 , with the ability to manage payroll across multiple entities and locations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage the end\-to\-end monthly payroll process for 400\+ employees, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and compliance.
* Validate and process payroll inputs including attendance, leave, variable pay, incentives, reimbursements, deductions, new joiners, exits and salary revisions.
* Ensure timely and accurate compliance with PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS, Gratuity and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Manage monthly payroll taxation, TDS calculations, tax declarations, investment proofs and Form 16 processes.
* Conduct detailed payroll reconciliation across HRMS, payroll records, bank statements and Finance/accounting records.
* Work closely with Finance on payroll accounting, salary disbursement, month\-end closure and reconciliation.
* Prepare and publish payroll MIS, headcount reports, payroll analytics and management dashboards.
* Own periodic payroll and statutory audits, ensuring timely closure of observations and discrepancies.
* Handle employee queries related to salary, deductions, taxes, PF, reimbursements and statutory benefits.
* Maintain accurate payroll records and ensure strict confidentiality of employee compensation and personal data.
* Manage payroll/HRMS systems and ensure accurate employee master data and payroll configuration.
* Drive payroll process improvements, automation, controls, and standardization to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Coordinate with external payroll vendors, consultants, and statutory partners wherever required.
* Track changes in applicable tax, payroll, and statutory regulations and ensure timely implementation.
* Develop and maintain payroll SOPs, compliance trackers, process documentation and internal controls.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5–8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Payroll and Payroll Compliance.
* Strong experience managing end\-to\-end payroll independently for a mid\-sized or large organization.
* Strong working knowledge of PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS, Gratuity and other applicable statutory compliances.
* Hands\-on experience with payroll taxation and Form 16\.
* Experience with payroll/HRMS platforms such as Keka, Darwinbox, GreytHR, SAP, ADP or similar systems.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including payroll reconciliation, analysis and MIS reporting.
* Experience working closely with Finance on payroll accounting and reconciliation.
* Experience handling payroll audits and statutory audits.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to manage sensitive payroll and compensation information with complete confidentiality.
* Experience managing payroll across multiple entities or locations is a plus.
* Experience in payroll system implementation/migration is an added advantage.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
* A hands\-on payroll specialist with strong ownership of payroll and compliance.
* Strong understanding of the complete payroll cycle from inputs → processing → validation → reconciliation → statutory compliance → taxation → disbursement → reporting.
* Strong knowledge of payroll controls and ability to identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
* Ability to work effectively in a startup, fast\-growing, multi\-entity organization.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with HR, Finance, employees, auditors, and external vendors.
